decisions.reason: As a close-to-core CD with its own product page in two years, it reflects visible commitment and fits genre broadening, so management is likely to treat any weak demand as temporary rather than withdraw it.
This illustrated release series builds directly on the firm's established reissue model and was publicly presented on its own pages, so sunk effort and strategic fit favor keeping it.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP matches the firm's move into broader genres and formats and was launched visibly, making management more inclined to persist than to admit a mistaken extension.
The multi-disc box set likely involved comparatively high upfront production and was given its own page, so escalation of commitment makes removal relatively unlikely.

This compilation CD was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, so with lower public commitment and likely lower dedicated investment it is the easiest product for management to take off the market.
